reasoning_traces.think:
The observability framework operates as a conditional system governed by two core variables: SENTRY_DSN and NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN. These define a binary state space for error tracking readiness. The system exhibits a dual nature—server-side instrumentation activates only when SENTRY_DSN is present, while client-side initialization mirrors this. Error capture mechanisms are guarded by an _initialized flag, which is set during Sentry.init(). This creates a layered control structure where observability readiness is a composite function of environmental state and runtime initialization. The failure mode arises when either DSN is missing, leading to no-op behavior and silent loss of error telemetry. The system's robustness hinges on consistent DSN propagation through deployment environments, with no fallback mechanism for error reporting.
